mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the GDP growth rate signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining GDP growth are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
